name: Andou Misaki
source:
Specialty: Intensive training, playing violin
Hobbies: Tea
Likes: Sleeping, texting, friendships with boys
Dislikes: Insects, messy places, women who gossip

Rei's kouhai who is competitive and very passionate, and a girl who prefers effort-intensive training that yields results. Very emotional and moody but also awkward as Misaki has always been in the top and always cares about results, thinking about nothing else. For some reason, Misaki sees Rei as her rival and wants to surprass him no matter what.

"If you're a good boy, I'll give you my personal stamp of approval!"
